claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: CGP-54626 is a potent, selective GABAB receptor antagonist with no intrinsic cytotoxic activity; at 2.5 uM it is expected to be largely inactive against cancer cell lines, as GABAB receptors are not required for cancer cell viability.
